Our Culture



Growth Mindset
The belief that intelligence can be developed
The belief that growth comes with consistency
 

Building families, not Work Relationships
Bond over a cup of (virtual) coffee or beer
Build strong bonds that stay beyond your time with us

Hierarchy- free Structure
We trust you with the company's responsibilities
We welcome you to explore new areas of your interest		    



Embrace the Differences
We are not like minded and we love that
Be yourself. Express your views without any fear



Honest and Frank Communication
We are all-in for open conversations
We respect your perspective and trust you to convey it with full honesty.


Outcome focused
Start and finish your workday depending on your to-do list
